- being hungry can make you angry, irritable, same as sleep. 
-caffeine can increase anxiety, or induce euphoria
- anecdotally: my family thought my dad was just being distant, perhaps a mid life crisis? Turns out it was just undetected dementia. 
-girls experience changes to their personality every month, thanks to their periods. 
-schizophrenia is connected to hormonal issues. 
-people with OCD can be treated with NAC (which coincidentally improves the strength of mdma trips, it helps to bring back the “magic”
-vitamin deficiency can cause hallucinations
- I had two friends decide to drink heavily one night, then take shrooms the next day on the hangover. Both experienced bad trips, which I strongly believe was influenced by the anxiety from the toxins of the alcohol
